{{Top|leg}}
'''Octensen''' was a [[Lubricant/Legends|lubricant]] developed by [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]]. It was a white, foamy substance used to lubricate [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines.<ref name="Crisis on Cloud City">[[Crisis on Cloud City (adventure book)|''Crisis on Cloud City'']]</ref>
